title: CatalogResponse
description: Authenticated envelope describing an uploaded encrypted catalog snapshot. The relay stores only this metadata plus the R2 ciphertext object; it never receives plaintext or the decryption key.

ciphertextDigest.description: Digest of the compressed ciphertext stored in R2, authenticated by this envelope's signature.

ciphertextSizeBytes.description: MUST NOT exceed the service's maximum compressed/encrypted catalog size (see constants.json).

nonce.description: AES-256-GCM nonce, unique per (senderDeviceKeyId, recipientDeviceKeyId) key pair.

senderEphemeralPublicKey.description: Sub's ephemeral ECDH public key used to derive the AEAD key with the Owner's ephemeral key from the matching catalog-request.
